# Hover Card

A preview that opens while the pointer rests on a link: the profile behind a mention, the page behind a link, the commit behind a hash. Popover's surface, grown out of the link it previews.

```tsx
<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger asChild>
    <Link href="/people/katiep" variant="prose">@katiep</Link>
  </HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent className="w-80">
    <div className="flex gap-3">
      <AvatarRoot size="lg">
        <AvatarImage src="https://i.pravatar.cc/160?img=5" alt="Katie Park" />
        <AvatarFallback>KP</AvatarFallback>
      </AvatarRoot>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <HoverCardTitle>Katie Park</HoverCardTitle>
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">@katiep · Design Systems at Koala</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <HoverCardDescription>Tokens, type and the occasional motion curve…</HoverCardDescription>
    {/* location and join date */}
    <HoverCardFooter className="gap-4">
      <span><span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">128</span> following</span>
      <span><span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">2,418</span> followers</span>
    </HoverCardFooter>
  </HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add hover-card
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/hover-card/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  HoverCard,
  HoverCardTrigger,
  HoverCardContent,
} from "@/components/ui/hover-card"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <HoverCard>
      <HoverCardTrigger asChild>
        <a href="/people/katiep">@katiep</a>
      </HoverCardTrigger>
      <HoverCardContent>Katie Park, Design Systems</HoverCardContent>
    </HoverCard>
  )
}
```

## Link preview

The page behind a link. `HoverCardMedia` sets the picture 8px in from the card's edges instead of bleeding to them, with concentric corners (the card's 16px radius minus 8px of inset leaves 8px on the picture). The copy under it keeps the card's own 16px. It is aspect-video until you give it another ratio.

```tsx
<HoverCardContent className="w-80">
  <HoverCardMedia>
    <img src="…" alt="A style guide spread" />
  </HoverCardMedia>
  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-1">
    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">koalaui.com/changelog</span>
    <HoverCardTitle>Koala 2.4: density comes to every form</HoverCardTitle>
    <HoverCardDescription>One size prop across fields, selects and buttons…</HoverCardDescription>
  </div>
</HoverCardContent>
```

## Commit preview

A reference in running text, opened into what it points at: the subject, the author, and the size of the change. The counts sit in `HoverCardFooter`, a muted well set in from the card's edges like the media, where a divider line would otherwise go. They are `tabular-nums`, so a column of them lines up. `align="start"` opens the card from the hash's left edge.

```tsx
<HoverCard>
  <HoverCardTrigger asChild>
    <Link href="/commits/8f3a2c1" variant="prose" className="font-mono">8f3a2c1</Link>
  </HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent className="w-80" align="start">
    <HoverCardTitle>Select: cap the popper at the space left on screen</HoverCardTitle>
    {/* author row */}
    <HoverCardFooter className="justify-between">
      <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">
        <span className="text-success-strong">+128</span>
        <span className="text-destructive-strong">−14</span>
      </span>
      <Badge variant="success"><SealCheck weight="fill" /> Verified</Badge>
    </HoverCardFooter>
  </HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
```

## Placement

`side`, `align` and `sideOffset` are Radix's, and the card flips when the side you asked for has no room. `showArrow` adds a pointer toward the link. The card grows out of the trigger it previews, from Radix's transform origin, rather than from its own centre. These open after 150ms so you can sweep across them.

```tsx
<HoverCard openDelay={150}>
  <HoverCardTrigger asChild><Link href="#" variant="prose">Top</Link></HoverCardTrigger>
  <HoverCardContent side="top" showArrow density="compact" className="w-56">
    <HoverCardTitle>Opens top</HoverCardTitle>
    <HoverCardDescription>Collision-aware: it flips when there is no room on this side.</HoverCardDescription>
  </HoverCardContent>
</HoverCard>
```

## Timing

The card waits `openDelay` (700ms) before it opens, so a pointer passing over a paragraph full of links doesn't set off a string of cards, and `closeDelay` (300ms) after the pointer leaves, which is the time it has to cross the gap into the card. Both are props on `HoverCard`. Shorten the open delay where the preview is the point (a list of people), and keep the close delay: without it the card vanishes on the way to it.

## Accessibility

A hover card is for sighted pointer users. It opens when the trigger has focus, but the card never takes focus and it never opens on touch, so everything in it must also be reachable where the link goes. Make the trigger a real link to that place, and never put the only way to do something inside the card. When the content has to be operated, use a Popover, which opens on a click and moves focus into itself.

## API reference

### HoverCard

The root, Radix `HoverCard.Root`; renders no DOM. Every part that renders an element accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| openDelay | number | 700 | Milliseconds the pointer rests on the trigger before the card opens. |
| closeDelay | number | 300 | Milliseconds after the pointer leaves before the card closes: the time it has to cross into the card. |
| open | boolean | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | boolean | false | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the card opens or closes. |

### HoverCardTrigger

The link being previewed, Radix `HoverCard.Trigger`. Renders an `<a>` and forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own link (a `Link`, a Next.js link) instead of rendering an `<a>`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |

### HoverCardContent

The card, Radix `HoverCard.Content` portalled to the body; forwards all its props. Declares `--surface`, so a nested control blends with the card.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| side | "top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left" | "bottom" | Preferred side of the trigger; the card flips when there is no room. |
| align | "start" \| "center" \| "end" | "center" | Alignment against the trigger. |
| sideOffset | number | 8 | Gap in pixels between the trigger and the card. |
| collisionPadding | number | 8 | Distance in pixels kept from the viewport edge. |
| showArrow | boolean | false | Render a small pointer toward the trigger. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | Padding: 16px or 12px. Falls back to the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |
| data-side | The side the card actually opened on, after collisions. |
| data-align | `"start"`, `"center"` or `"end"`. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --radix-hover-card-content-transform-origin | The trigger-side origin the card grows from. |
| --radix-hover-card-content-available-width | Width left between the trigger and the viewport edge. |
| --radix-hover-card-content-available-height | Height left between the trigger and the viewport edge. |
| --surface | Set to `var(--popover)`, read by nested Inputs and Selects. |

### HoverCardTitle

The card's heading. Forwards all native `<h4>` props.

### HoverCardDescription

Muted supporting copy under the title. Forwards all native `<p>` props.

### HoverCardMedia

One `<img>` or `<video>`, aspect-video, set 8px in from the card's edges (4px compact) with concentric corners. Put it first or last. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### HoverCardFooter

A muted flex row inset like the media; always the last part. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

## FAQ

### Hover Card, Tooltip or Popover?

A Tooltip names a control in a few words and never takes the pointer. A Hover Card previews where a link goes, and the pointer can move into it. A Popover opens on a click and takes focus, so it is the one for anything that has to be operated: forms, pickers, confirmations.

### Can the card hold links and buttons?

Links, yes: the pointer can move into the card and follow one. Keep buttons to shortcuts for things that also exist on the linked page, since keyboard and touch users never see the card.

### Why doesn't it open on my phone?

There is no hover on touch, and a tap has to follow the link. That is why the trigger must be a real link that goes where the card was previewing.

### Why is the trigger an anchor?

Because a hover card previews a destination, and the trigger is how you get there. Radix renders an `<a>`; with `asChild` you pass your own Link, which keeps client-side navigation.

### Why does it look exactly like a Popover?

It is built on Popover's recipe, extended rather than copied, so a change to the popover surface reaches both. The one addition is the transform origin: the card grows out of the link instead of from its own centre.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add hover-card` writes `components/ui/hover-card/`. Import from `@/components/ui/hover-card`:

- Components and helpers: `HoverCard`, `HoverCardTrigger`, `HoverCardContent`, `HoverCardTitle`, `HoverCardDescription`, `HoverCardMedia`, `HoverCardFooter`, `hoverCardVariants`
- Types: `HoverCardContentProps`
- Koala components it installs with it: `popover`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `density`, `tv`
- npm packages: `radix-ui`
